notes: durationMs is the wall-clock duration of the whole run, which executed 20 tests across two capabilities plus the seed test. This record covers only the 11 ETA-411 tests. The eight ETA-351 tests also passed in the same run but belong to EXEC-ETA-351-001's capability and are not restated here.

The first run of this suite on 2026-09-01 recorded 4 failures. All four were automation defects; none was an application defect and none was filed as a bug. (1) TS-ETA-411-001 omitted the step that chooses organization sign-in, so it filled a field the login page had not yet rendered. Fixed by amending the approved feature file, which returned the workflow to Gate 3 and was re-approved at artifactVersion 2. (2) TS-ETA-411-004, TS-ETA-411-009 and the Workspace row of TS-ETA-411-006 asserted a visible heading named 'Search Criteria' on the Workspace page. No such heading exists. It was introduced from a validation probe that read textContent from legend and caption elements without checking ARIA role or visibility, and the claim has been retracted in reports/validation/ETA-411-playwright-validation.md. The reviewer chose to revert EcoreWorkspacePage to the address-only assertion that TP-ETA-411-001 approved.

After that revert the Workspace row of TS-ETA-411-006 still timed out on wall clock alone: sign-in plus a single Workspace navigation consumed 27.3s of the 30s default. playwright.config.ts now sets timeout to 90000. The expect timeout is unchanged at 5s, so a genuinely missing element still fails fast. This raised a budget, not an assertion.

Evidence for that first failing run was lost. A diagnostic re-run with --grep overwrote reports/execution/results.json and reports/playwright-report/, which Playwright writes to fixed paths on every run. The per-scenario durations of the 16 results from the failing run cannot be recovered, so no execution record was written for it rather than inventing numbers. The incident is recorded as EVIDENCE_LOST in workflow/history/WF-ETA-411-R1.0.history.jsonl.

Trace ids are not one-to-one with rows here. TS-ETA-411-006 is a Scenario Outline with three example rows, and all three verify the single criterion AC-ETA-411-006, so all three carry TRC-ETA-411-006. The row is distinguished by gherkinScenario, not by trace id, because the RTM holds one trace per acceptance criterion.

TS-ETA-411-005 is the only approved route to the Preferences page while AMB-ETA-411-006 remains REVIEW_REQUIRED. A PASSED result here does not confirm that the header 'Organization' link is or is not a second route to that page.

Every scenario in this suite signs in with the single real organization account from env.requireEcoreLogin(). RISK-TP-ETA-411-004 is therefore undischarged: these results say nothing about what a different account, role or permission set sees on the Home page.

The npm test run also emitted a browser code coverage summary. That measures which application JavaScript executed and is unrelated to requirement coverage. It is not evidence for any acceptance criterion and must not be merged into traceability/.
